segments.title: Guess this 440-year-old lock code
segments.say: This lock sank in fifteen eighty three. Its code has four letters. Gold, A N C E, or Ship? Three. Two. One.

segments.title: It's ANCE!
segments.sub: Opened for the **first time in 400+ years**
segments.say: It's A, N, C, E! And it opened for the first time in over four hundred years.

segments.title: A 3D X-ray cracked it
segments.say: Scientists at Cardiff University used micro CT scans to match the notches inside to the letters.

segments.title: Why ANCE? Nobody knows
segments.sub: Did it mean something **to its owner?**
segments.say: Why A N C E? Nobody knows. Maybe it meant something to its owner.
What do you think it stands for? Comment below.
